##### Thorburn Landscapes

Established in 2011, we have built up a solid reputation as a trustworthy, dedicated company that will do everything to ensure your satisfaction. In this time we have built up a great portfolio of jobs and a fantastic client base, with many of our clients referring us on to their friends and colleagues as dependable and high quality contractors.

In addition to Checkatrade we are also members of the Association of Professional Landscapers, the Horticultural Trade Association.

##### We offer a comprehensive list of landscaping/gardening services including design, landscaping, maintenance, make-overs, fencing, planting and much more.

**Design & Landscaping**

We provide a full design and landscaping service that brings together our gardening knowledge with your ideas and inspirations. We will sit down and draw a detailed design that fits your needs and your budget. Then we take that vision and use our planting and landscaping expertise to build you the garden of your dreams.

**Garden Maintenance**

We want your garden to look at its best all year round and as part of our service, we can provide you with garden maintenance that suits your individual needs. Our staff are highly knowledgeable when it comes to plants and will be able to offer services that include lawn care, pest control, wisteria, plant care and general regular clean-ups and trimming. We can also assess and maintain your decking, patio and outbuildings.

**Garden Make overs and Fencing**

We can add/update your patio, deck, or path. Small additions that will complete your garden and give you your perfect space. We also install all types of fencing and trellis
